rows.note: Use 表演 as the all-purpose noun for a live show or concert.

example.traditional: 今晚嘅表演真係好精彩。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ge3 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use 效率 when performance means how much useful work is produced with the time or resources used.

example.english: The new machine's performance is much better.
example.traditional: 呢部新機嘅效率高好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 san1 gei1 ge3 haau6 leot6 gou1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 成就 for the achievement or accomplishment resulting from an action, rather than the act of carrying it out.

example.english: Our team's completion of this major project was a major performance.
example.traditional: 我哋團隊完成呢個大型項目，係一大成就。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tyun4 deoi6 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 daai6 jing4 hong6 muk6 hai6 jat1 daai6 sing4 zau6

rows.note: Use 執行 for the carrying out or implementation of a task, duty, plan, or undertaking.

example.english: The performance of this contract is our responsibility.
example.traditional: 執行呢份合約係我哋嘅責任。
example.jyutping: zap1 hang4 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zaak3 jam6
